A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same study. Their main text, equations, figures and complete appendices are readable, and retained analyses can be matched across the appendix expansion and renumbering.

before.justification: v1 reports original layer interventions, residual-erasure analyses, trained cross-model linear maps, and Transformer/MoEUT training experiments.

after.justification: v3 retains those original empirical results and adds sample-size/dataset robustness experiments and OLMo 2 analyses.

M1.justification: The layer-skipping, local-intervention, residual-erasure, integrated-gradients, Logitlens and linear-mapping procedures are retained. OLMo 2 supplies additional models to analyze; no new diagnostic algorithm or training objective is specified.

E1.justification: GSM8K, MATH, MQuAKE, DeepMind Math arithmetic and the leaderboard analyses remain the data/task coverage. MATH was already evaluated in v1; its additional use for robustness diagnostics does not introduce a new task or population.

E2.justification: The Transformer/MoEUT comparison and base, instruction-tuned and fine-tuned controls are retained. OLMo 2 is an additional subject of the existing diagnostics. Newly cited Peri-LN and Mix-LN are not evaluated as competing methods.

E3.justification: v3 substantially extends model configurations through OLMo 2 7B, 13B and 32B, including a different normalization arrangement. Appendix C adds dataset and sample-size control conditions, including 50-example GSM8K evaluations. These supplement the retained protocols rather than establish that the original experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: New Appendix C tests whether residual contributions, layer-skipping effects and Logitlens findings depend on dataset choice or small samples (Figs. 10–12). Figure 13 adds individual-example layer-skipping analyses, while the OLMo 2 suite extends circuit and computation-depth analyses across another architecture.

E5.justification: The regression confidence interval in Fig. 1 and significance reporting in Appendix B are retained. No new seeds, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals or significance procedures appear. Larger evaluation samples and individual-example heatmaps add robustness evidence without changing statistical uncertainty estimation.

E6.justification: v3 adds extensive robustness and OLMo 2 results, including stronger direct layer interactions for OLMo 2 (Fig. 29) and broadly similar complexity-depth trends. Several retained absolute-norm results also change: the Llama 3.1 70B MLP-norm peak rises from approximately 7 in v1 Fig. 11 to over 100 in v3 Fig. 15. The cause is not explained.

T1.justification: The Transformer equations and definitions of interventions, depth score and linear-map error are retained. No substantive mathematical derivation, assumption revision, theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: The central claims about underused later layers, complexity-independent computation depth, stretched computation in deeper models and MoEUT's potential remain unchanged. Naming OLMo 2 in the abstract expands supporting evidence without redefining those claims.

C2.justification: v3 adds a variability-based justification for maximum aggregation, tentatively attributes OLMo 2's stronger interactions to normalization placement, and connects weak later-layer attention to massive activations (Appendices C/F; Fig. 29). The main discussion and stated limitations are otherwise retained.

D1.justification: Figure 29 newly describes OLMo 2's normalization after layer computation and before residual merging. Existing code access, DeepMind Math preprocessing, fine-tuning hyperparameters and hardware/runtime disclosures are retained; the addition is limited technical documentation.

R1.justification: v3 adds Qwen 3 and OLMo 2 references and focused discussion of Peri-LN, Mix-LN, massive activations and selective attention. The earlier positioning relative to layer-skipping and interpretability research remains substantially intact.

P1.justification: Most main-text prose and the narrative sequence are retained. Changes include a new robustness appendix section, local explanatory additions, updated cross-references, and conference/funding headers; there is no extensive rewrite.

P2.justification: v3 adds substantial multipanel robustness and OLMo 2 figure suites, redraws several norm/cosine plots with wider bars and revised axes or legends, and redistributes appendix figures. Existing analyses are largely retained under new numbering rather than removed.

improvement.justification: Compared with v1's small-sample main analyses, v3 checks 50 GSM8K examples and repeats central diagnostics on MATH, while OLMo 2 broadens architectural validation. This strengthens empirical credibility. The improvement remains limited by the retained single-pair linear-mapping and qualitative-case limitations, and unexplained changes in absolute-norm plots reduce clarity.
